answer.explanation: CompressionFunction logged 384 errors between 11:04:29 and 11:14:25 UTC, all of the form 'NoSuchBucket ... PutObject ... The specified bucket does not exist' at S3.put_object(Bucket=OUTPUT_BUCKET). The errors are continuous across several log streams, and the other three functions (CrudApi, Uploader, Thumbnailer) show no errors in the window. NoSuchBucket points to a bad bucket name in the live OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable, not an IAM denial (which would appear as AccessDenied). I could not read the function's live configuration or the IaC template directly with the tools available, so the bucket name value itself is unverified. The IAC candidate is listed because the template may be the source of the bad value.
